info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Risk Models API
info.description: The Business Risk Models API provides developers with access to a comprehensive suite of risk assessment tools tailored for banking applications. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about various business risk models employed by financial institutions. Typical consumers of this API include banking software developers, risk management teams, and compliance officers seeking to enhance their risk assessment capabilities. By integrating these models, organizations can better evaluate potential financial threats and make informed decisions regarding risk management.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of business risk models.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of business risk models available in the system. You can use this to assess potential risks in various business scenarios.
